text.tspan: Expected years of schooling among girls and boys in secondary education
For each year, this shows how many years a child starting school then can expect to spend in secondary
education if current enrollment patterns stay the same. It includes repeated grades.
Data source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026)
